name: event_id
description: Immutable id of one normalized event.

name: correlation_id
description: Id that ties this event to one autonomous run.

name: sku
description: Product SKU carried by the event.

name: quantity
description: Positive quantity carried by the event.

name: occurred_at
description: When the event happened. Partition field. Not the ingest time.

name: ingested_at
description: When the row was written. Not part of event identity.
